purpose: Prospective within-commit coherent one-line sequence pilot; no accepted labels until review
reason_for_revision: The v1 observed cross-commit rule yielded one structurally valid but uninferable pair in 40 repositories. This plan tests two real same-commit identifier substitutions with transparently synthetic order.
selection: The same first 40 frozen public seeds in round-robin Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go order; no replacement of failed repositories
source_license_policy: Pinned MIT repository license and no conflicting file SPDX notice; source-file scope requires later review
history_policy: Both one-line replacements appear in one real commit; the first-to-second editor order and intermediate buffer are synthetic and recorded as such
candidate_rule: Two one-line replacements within 80 rows in the same file and commit, each changing the same whole identifier token with no other token or whitespace change; at most one candidate per repository
acceptance: Exact replay and real commit atoms are necessary, then source-file rights, prompt budget, blind inferability, independent objective and mutation checks
expansion_gate: At least 24 independently accepted candidates among 40 attempted repositories, at least 5 per target language, and no unresolved license or split violation
